mandatory_findings.finding: Checkpoint omits explicit completed/incomplete gate states, observed-main observation time/evidence, and current worker/operation dispositions. HANDOFF and RECOVERY-STATUS falsely direct recovery to the checkpoint for those omitted facts.
mandatory_findings.required_change: Add a concise explicit phase table, observed main SHA/tree/time with evidence reference, current worker states and known current unknown operations (explicitly none when known); distinguish historical unknowns. Preserve existing observations and source-time fields.

mandatory_findings.finding: The early-package first action says save/readback then implement, but the same file unconditionally says incomplete P14 delivery means delivery-only and stop. This makes early recovery stop before its selected implementation phase.
mandatory_findings.required_change: Apply delivery-only recovery only when the final phase boundary has been reached. State that an early package resumes the declared phase after the early save gate and live reconciliation.
